name: Altered
description: Altered is a fast-paced, non-combative TCG of exploration where players lead expeditions into unknown lands . Instead of fighting each other, players race to complete quests and adapt to ever-changing challenges, using cards from six distinct factions with unique abilities .

name: Cardfight!! Vanguard
description: Cardfight!! Vanguard is a Japanese collectible card game where each player uses a \"Vanguard\" card (a lead unit) and \"Rear-guard\" units in a battle line. Players take turns calling units to the field and attacking the opponent's Vanguard or rear-guards. Cards have power values and special abilities; battles involve comparing power and using triggers to deal damage. A player wins by inflicting four points of damage on the opponent's Vanguard.

name: Digimon Card Game
description: The Digimon Card Game is a competitive TCG where each player controls a Digimon companion card in battle . Players draw cards, place Digimon to the field, and may evolve them into stronger forms. Each Digimon has power and attacks, and players also use Tamers and Option cards. The goal is to beat the opponent's security by dealing damage: when a Digimon's attack reduces the opponent's Security Area cards to zero, delivering the final hit wins the game.

name: Disney Lorcana TCG
description: Disney Lorcana is a magical trading card game in which players team up with beloved Disney characters-mixing heroes, villains, and supporting items from across Disney films-and race against opponents . Players summon characters to the field and use their unique abilities, and can spend a resource called “glitter” to play cards or power up. The ultimate objective is to collect 20 legendary artifacts (Lore item cards) to claim victory .

name: Dragon Ball Super Card Game
description: Dragon Ball Super Card Game is a two-player TCG where each deck includes one Leader card (a main Dragon Ball character) and a Battle deck of supporting cards . Players start with their Leader on the field and play energy to use Battle cards or perform actions. Leaders and Battle cards have skills and power values. Players attack each other's Leaders, and each time a player's Leader takes 1 damage (reach 4 damage), they lose . The first player to deal enough damage to make the opponent's Leader's life zero wins .

name: Duel Masters Trading Card Game
description: Duel Masters is a collectible card game where two players (or teams) duel as “duelists” summoning creatures and casting spells with mana, similar to Magic: the Gathering . Each player has five shield cards in front of them; when a creature attacks, it breaks a shield which goes into the player's hand. Once all shields are broken, one more attack wins the duel . If a player must draw from an empty deck, they also lose . Players build custom decks (minimum 40 cards) from their card collection to outmaneuver their opponent.

name: Force of Will TCG
description: Force of Will is a fantasy-themed trading card game in which two players duel as wizards. Each player has a character card called a J/ Ruler that serves as their avatar, and a deck of cards including spells and resonators (creatures) . Players generate “Magic Stones” as a resource, cast spells, summon resonators with power and abilities, and battle the opponent. The 1 1 2 2 3 4 5 6 6 7 8 8 9 1 J/Ruler can transform into its flipped (active) form to use more abilities. The goal is to reduce the opponent's life total to zero by inflicting damage through card effects .

name: Flesh and Blood TCG
description: Flesh and Blood is a heroic fantasy TCG where each player chooses a Hero with a unique class and builds a deck of cards representing gear and abilities for that Hero. Players start by drawing a hand, taking turns to attack with weapons or use action cards. Each attack can penetrate the opponent's defense stacks (cards played as gear), dealing damage. A player wins by reducing the opponent to 0 life (typically by dealing more damage than the life total) or by decking out the opponent.

name: Final Fantasy Trading Card Game
description: The Final Fantasy TCG is a card game in which players build decks themed around Final Fantasy characters and summons. Each player takes on the role of a chosen Final Fantasy hero (Leader) and draws cards, plays forwards and backups, and attacks the opponent's Leader. Cards have cost (Crystal Points) to play. The goal is to reduce the opponent Leader's life to zero by dealing damage through forward attacks and abilities.

name: Grand Archive TCG
description: Grand Archive is a trading card game in which two players use decks of cards representing powerful heroes and creatures to duel. Each player starts with a champion and fields followers (cards with power) in lanes. Players attack with cards, triggering abilities and drawing cards. Damage is tracked by putting cards into a damage zone. The first player to accumulate seven damage loses, making the opponent the winner.

name: KeyForge: Call of the Archons
description: KeyForge is a unique deck game where each player's deck (Archon deck) is algorithmically generated and completely unique. In a match, players take turns playing cards from their hand to muster creatures and artifacts in an attempt to gather three keys. Each card must be used as either resources (chains) to power other cards or played for its effect. The first player to forge three keys (by ending a turn with at least three unbroken chains) wins the game.

name: Magic: The Gathering
description: Magic: The Gathering is a strategic fantasy card game where players assume the roles of planeswalkers, powerful wizards battling each other with decks of spells and creatures. On their turn, each player draws a card and may play a land to generate mana, which is spent to cast spells or summon creatures. Players attack with creatures and cast spells to reduce the opponent's life total from 20 to 0. The game emphasizes strategic deckbuilding, resource management (mana), and interaction through spells and abilities.

name: Marvel Champions: The Card Game
description: Marvel Champions is a cooperative living card game in which 1–4 players each take on the role of an iconic Marvel hero, building a hero deck and playing a scenario against a villain. Players alternate turns performing actions: playing ally, upgrade, or support cards, switching between hero and alter-ego forms, and using their character's superpowers. The villain controls threats and a scheme. The heroes win by depleting the villain's hit points, while the heroes lose if the villain's scheme advances to its final stage or they are defeated .

name: MetaZoo TCG
description: MetaZoo is a monster-themed trading card game where players construct decks with creatures inspired by cryptids and mythological beings. On each turn, players draw cards, place a Cryptid card in play (a creature with stats), and play magic or trap cards. Cryptid cards have combat points and 9 10 2 special abilities. Players attack with their Cryptids; when an attack is declared, the opponent may choose to block with another Cryptid. Unblocked attacks deal damage to the opponent. If a player's life points reach zero, they lose.

name: One Piece Card Game
description: The ONE PIECE Card Game is a collectible card game themed on the One Piece manga and anime. Players create a “crew” deck using their favorite characters from the series . Each player has one Leader card (a character) and a deck of character, event, and stage cards. Players draw cards, play cards to the field (incurring cost in berries), and use character attacks and events to score damage. The first player to deal seven points of damage to the opponent's Leader wins .

name: Panini Adrenalyn XL
description: Panini Adrenalyn XL is a soccer-themed trading card game where each player builds a squad of 11 player cards plus 3 substitutes (one goalkeeper and players for attack, midfield, defense) . In each round, both players choose a player card and a stat (Attack, Defense, or Control) to contest secretly . Cards are revealed and the chosen stats are compared: the higher stat scores a goal. Play continues, with substitutions possible, until a predetermined number of rounds. The player with more goals at the end wins .

name: Pokémon Trading Card Game
description: The Pokémon TCG is a collectible card game where two players battle as Pokémon Trainers. Each player uses a deck of Pokémon creature cards, Trainer cards, and Energy cards . Players place one Basic Pokémon as their Active Pokémon and may have up to five on the Bench. They attach Energy cards to their Pokémon to enable attacks. Each Pokémon has Hit Points (HP); if an attack deals damage equal or greater than the opponent's Pokémon's HP, it is knocked out and removed. When a player knocks out an opponent's Pokémon, they take one Prize card. The first player to take all their Prize cards (typically six) wins the game .

name: Shadowverse: Evolve
description: Shadowverse: Evolve is a digital-origin card game also released in physical form, featuring characters and creatures from the Shadowverse universe. Each player builds a deck and uses a turn-based system drawing cards and playing follower and spell cards using evolution points and play points. Followers attack opposing followers or the opponent's life total. Special evolution mechanics allow certain cards to become stronger. A player loses when their life total is reduced to zero.

name: Star Wars: Unlimited
description: Star Wars: Unlimited is a strategy card game set in the Star Wars universe. Players construct a deck featuring iconic characters and locations from the Star Wars galaxy. Each player deploys units (heroes, vehicles, troopers) and locations to the field. They then use resource cards to play cards and activate abilities. Players take turns attacking with their units; damage is tracked, and a player loses if their health (customizable health trackers) reaches zero or their deck is exhausted.

name: Topps Match Attax
description: Topps Match Attax is a soccer (football) trading card game. Each player selects a squad of 11 player cards and up to 3 substitutes, placed in a formation . In play, each round one player declares whether they are attacking or defending, and both choose a player card simultaneously . The chosen cards are revealed: if the attacker's card power beats the defender's, the attacker scores a goal and wins that round. Tactic cards can provide special abilities. The game continues through set rounds, and the player 11 11 12 13 13 14 1415 16 1617 3 with the most goals wins .

name: Union Arena TCG
description: Union Arena is a cross-franchise “Common Rules” trading card game by Bandai. Players only learn one rule set to use cards featuring characters from various series (like anime). Each player builds a 50-card deck around one series, including Character, Site, and Event cards . On a player's turn, they use \"Action Point\" cards and play characters or events to attack the opponent's characters or castle. The objective is to deplete the opponent's castle points to zero by inflicting damage. Because cards can mix characters from different series, players enjoy diverse battles .

name: Universus
description: UniVersus is a multi-franchise TCG where players collect cards featuring characters from various pop culture properties . Each player constructs a deck and plays with two chosen Leaders (characters) from any franchises. On their turn, players play cards including Characters and Battle cards, activating their abilities and attacking with them. Characters have power and sometimes bonds with other franchises. Players form teams and brawl; the first player to reduce the opponent's life to zero with their combined forces wins.

name: WIXOSS TCG
description: WIXOSS is a Japanese trading card game where two players battle as “Selectors” partnered with three LRIG cards (your avatars) . The Center LRIG is the main character card, and two Assist LRIGs provide support. Players take turns placing cards (including the LRIG) from their hand to generate resources, draw cards, and play Signi (creature) cards. When attacking, one player's Signi or LRIG challenges the opponent's Signi; if the opponent has no matching Signi, the defender takes damage. Players win by reducing the opponent's life to zero (readying all of the opponent's life counters) .

name: Weiß Schwarz
description: Weiß Schwarz is a Japanese crossover trading card game featuring characters from various anime and video games. Each player builds a deck of 50 cards from one franchise and uses it to battle. Cards include characters, events, and climaxes. Players each have 4 life and 5 cards in a hand initially. Each turn, players draw and play a character card onto the stage (front row or back row). Characters have power and soul (damage) values. When attacking, the attacking player adds power to their character's soul and compares to the defending character. Any overflow deals damage to the opponent's life (stacking damage tokens). After 4 damage, a player “flips” (shakes) their deck and puts 7 more cards into hand (akin to losing a life). A player loses when they must flip 8th time (taking 8 damage) or their deck is empty when needed to draw. The winner is the player who causes the opponent to reach this defeat condition.

name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game
description: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG is a fast-paced duel card game where two players each use a 40-60 card Deck of Monster, Spell, and Trap cards. Players take turns summoning Monster cards (using Tributes if needed), and activating Spell/Trap cards to battle. Each Monster has an Attack and Defense value. In battle, attacking monsters compare their ATK to the opponent's DEF or ATK (depending on attack direction) to determine damage. Each player starts with 8000 Life Points; when a player's Life Points reach 0, they lose .
